'''''Platygyrium''''' is a genus of [[mosses]] belonging to the family [[Hypnaceae]].<ref name="GBIF">{{cite web |title=Platygyrium Schimp. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/2682513 |website=www.gbif.org |access-date=24 February 2021 |language=en}}</ref><ref name="WFO">{{cite web|url=http://www.worldfloraonline.org/taxon/wfo-4000030113|website=www.worldfloraonline.org/|title=Hypnaceae Schimp.|access-date=25 May 2022}}</ref>

The species of this genus are found in Eurasia and Northern America.<ref name="GBIF" />

* ''[[Platygyrium australe]]'' (Dixon & Sainsbury) T.Arikawa

* ''Platygyrium fuscoluteum'' Cardot
* ''Platygyrium inflexum'' (Harv.) A. Jaeger
* ''Platygyrium intricatum'' (Hedw.) M. Fleisch.
* ''Platygyrium julaceum'' (Hook. ex Schwägr.) Bosch & Sande Lac.
* ''Platygyrium repens'' (Brid.) Schimp.
* ''Platygyrium russulum'' (Mitt.) A. Jaeger
* ''Platygyrium squarrosulum'' (Mont.) A. Jaeger
